B0D29Y1L5H.title: Z-Wave USB Interface/Radio/Dongle (SmartStick G8), 800 Series Mesh & Long Range Z-Wave Technology, Compatible with HomeSeer, Home Assistant, OpenHAB
bullets: ⚠️ READ FIRST: This USB stick is not a stand-alone hub. It must be used with smart home software running on a computer or on a Z-Wave compatible smart home hub such as HomeSeer HomeTroller or Home Assistant Green.

💡 WORKS WITH ALL Z-WAVE DEVICES: SmartStick G8 can control both standard Z-Wave devices (mesh network) and Long Range (LR) devices at the same time. You can mix and manage both types of devices in your home as long as you're using compatible software like HomeSeer or Home Assistant.

📏 INCREDIBLE LONG RANGE CAPABILITY: SmartStick G8 supports the latest 800 Series Z-Wave Long Range technology, offering wireless coverage of up to 1 mile. To use this feature, you'll need LR-compatible software and hubs, like Z-Wave JS UI v9.10.0 (or later) paired with HomeSeer or Home Assistant. Note: Your devices also need to support Z-Wave LR and be added as LR devices.

👆 EASY UPGRADE FROM OLDER CONTROLLERS: If you're upgrading from a previous Z-Wave controller (500, 700, or 800 series), SmartStick G8 makes it easy to migrate your Z-Wave network. Just use Z-Wave JS UI v9.9.0 (or later) for the migration. This feature works with HomeSeer and Home Assistant. Important: Don't use other methods (like PC Controller) for migration—they could make the stick unusable.
🌎 GLOBAL COMPATIBILITY: Works with all Z-Wave frequencies used in most coutries around the world (frequency is set using HomeSeer or Home Assistant software or hub).

🔮 FUTURE-PROOF WITH FIRMWARE UPDATES: SmartStick G8 comes with the latest Z-Wave firmware (version ZDK 7.22.2 as of 10/25/24) installed. You can update it as new versions are released, so it stays up-to-date with the latest technology.

B0G52DX5M3.title: Homey Pro (2026) | Smart Hub for Home Automation – Features Z-Wave Plus, Zigbee, Wi-Fi, BLE, Infrared, Matter & Thread. Compatible with Siri, Alexa & Google Home.
bullets: YOUR HOME CONNECTED: Bring all your smart home devices together with Homey Pro and experience a home that truly works in harmony. With double the RAM, this new version lets you add even more devices, so your smart home can grow without limits and feel more complete than ever. Whether you're at home or halfway around the world, you can effortlessly manage, monitor, and automate your entire setup. Stay in control with real-time insights, track historical energy usage, and receive sensor alerts—everything you need to keep your home running smoothly, all from one place.

YOUR HOME, YOUR RULES: Make all your devices work together seamlessly with Homey Flow. Switch your entire home off with the push of a button. Automatically play music when you arrive home. Create Flows right within the Homey app on your phone, or create Advanced Flows in the Homey Web App.

THE BRANDS YOU LOVE: Homey Pro works with over 50,000 devices from more than 1,000 brands. Thanks to Homey’s open platform, new devices are added daily, and Homey Pro supports both Official and Community-built Homey Apps. VISIT THE HOMEY WEBSITE TO CHECK ALL COMPATIBLE BRANDS.

SEVEN(!) TECHNOLOGIES IN ONE LOCAL-FIRST HUB: Homey Pro features Wi-Fi, Zigbee, Z-Wave Plus, Infrared, BLE, Matter and Thread. That’s more protocols than any other smart home hub. These are all controlled locally: Homey Pro processes everything on-premise. Your data is stored on Homey Pro itself, and cloud-dependency is minimalized.
POWERFUL ENERGY SAVINGS: Automate your home to save energy, or schedule your usage according to solar generation. Save on your energy bill without losing any comfort.
